commit 8c8cefb5bd4f1e966b11e38326058a5940be87fd
Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Mon Aug 11 21:39:18 2025 +0000
Commit:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Mon Aug 11 21:39:18 2025 +0000

    Bug 1981291 - Update official branding directory during merges. r=coreycb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D260080

diff --git a/mail/confvars.sh b/mail/confvars.sh
old mode 100755
new mode 100644
index cda9184b6b4..1f72a9903ab
--- a/mail/confvars.sh
+++ b/mail/confvars.sh
@@ -4,3 +4,7 @@
 # file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
 
 MOZ_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/nightly
+
+# This line is present (but intentionally unset) in comm-central to accommodate
+# merge automation branding updates for MSIX repackaging.
+MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=
diff --git a/mail/moz.configure b/mail/moz.configure
index 191cb07dc47..76df27485b5 100644
--- a/mail/moz.configure
+++ b/mail/moz.configure
@@ -181,11 +181,14 @@ def thunderbird_official_branding_directory(thunderbird_official_branding):
     return f"comm/mail/branding/{thunderbird_official_branding}"
 
 
-imply_option(
-    "MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY",
-    thunderbird_official_branding_directory,
-    reason=thunderbird_official_branding,
-)
+# This is disabled in favor of MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY being defined in
+# confvars.h, as MSIX repackaging does not support reading values from
+# moz.configure.
+# imply_option(
+#    "MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY",
+#    thunderbird_official_branding_directory,
+#    reason=thunderbird_official_branding,
+# )
 
 # Thunderbird Rust code is now the only way to compile
 set_config("MOZ_THUNDERBIRD_RUST", True)
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/merge-automation/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/merge-automation/kind.yml
index a25c7c4b74a..67bd0c9ed95 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/merge-automation/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/merge-automation/kind.yml
@@ -106,6 +106,10 @@ tasks:
                                   - - suite/config/version_display.txt
                                     - a1
                                     - b1
+                              regex-replacements:
+                                  - - mail/confvars.sh
+                                    - 'MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=.*$'
+                                    - 'MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/tb_beta'
                               merge-old-head: true
                               base-tag: 'BETA_{major_version}_BASE'
                               end-tag: 'BETA_{major_version}_END'
@@ -123,6 +127,10 @@ tasks:
                                   - - suite/config/version_display.txt
                                     - b1
                                     - ''
+                              regex-replacements:
+                                  - - mail/confvars.sh
+                                    - 'MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=.*$'
+                                    - 'MOZ_OFFICIAL_BRANDING_DIRECTORY=comm/mail/branding/thunderbird'
                               merge-old-head: true
                               base-tag: 'RELEASE_{major_version}_BASE'
                               end-tag: 'RELEASE_{major_version}_END'
title: Bug 1981291 - Update official branding directory during merges. r=coreycb
